Sarah L.: Heads-up: planning a quiet release tomorrow 09:00 PT for metrics-dashboard v2. Need RN + internal announce pinned by EOD. @Ajay P. @Maria O. :eyes:

Ajay P.: ok, what's the change window?

Sarah L.: change window 09:00-10:30 PT. Canary for 15 mins, then ramp 10%.

Kim (deploy-bot): deploy queued for staging -> canary at 2026-03-21T16:00Z

Sarah L.: RN draft in gdoc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/xxx — please comment. Paste below for quick review:

```Release notes
- Feature: faster KV-cache invalidation for long-chat -> reduces cold-starts
- Fix: retry logic on model routing to avoid 503s during autoscale
- Note: no schema migration
```

Ajay P.: LGTM, can we add a rollback blurb?

Sarah L.: added: 'rollback: pin previous model v1.4.2 and force route if any 5xx after canary.'

Maria O.: Ops: confirm oncall handoff? @oncall-sre

oncall-sre: I'll be standby. What's the fallback SLA?

Leo R.: fallback: if latency >200ms P95 or error rate >2% we rollback and route traffic to dedicated pool.

Sarah L.: final ask: product + ops approvals by 17:00 PT. I'll pin the internal announce to #eng-releases when approved.

Maria O.: approved. I'll prep the staff note and include the canary checklist.

Kim (deploy-bot): deploy started — canary 10:05 PT

Sarah L.: Thanks everyone. I'll post the internal announce 30 mins before go. :thumbsup:
